create_client.title: Create a client
create_client.description: Create a white-label client user, optionally without sending them the login email.

skip_login_email.description: True not to email the client a login link.

generate_login_token.title: Generate a login token
generate_login_token.description: Generate a token that logs a user straight into your white-label app (append it as #token), either to connect a new LinkedIn account or to re-login an existing one.

account_id.description: Account to re-login; omit to generate a token for connecting a new account.

list_accounts.title: List accounts
list_accounts.description: List the LinkedIn sender accounts connected to the workspace, with their ids and status.

get_account.title: Get an account
get_account.description: Read one connected LinkedIn account's profile and connection state.

get_account_limits.title: Get account limits
get_account_limits.description: Read an account's weekly limits for connection requests and InMails.

set_account_limits.title: Set account limits
set_account_limits.description: Change an account's weekly connection-request and InMail limits (1-1000 each; 50-200 is safest against LinkedIn restrictions).

get_account_file.title: Download a LinkedIn file
get_account_file.description: Fetch a LinkedIn file -- an attachment or image from a message -- through an account and stream it back. The response is the raw file, not JSON.

url.description: LinkedIn file URL, e.g. a message attachment. The tool percent-encodes it.

list_recent_leads.title: List recent leads
list_recent_leads.description: List the leads most recently gained across the workspace's campaigns and accounts.

list_interactions.title: List interactions
list_interactions.description: Chart the workspace's interactions -- views, connection requests, acceptances, messages, replies, InMails -- over a period in hourly or daily buckets, optionally for some accounts or one campaign.

account_ids.description: Account ids as a JSON array, e.g. ["123345678"]; omit for every account.

list_blacklisted_profiles.title: List blacklisted profiles
list_blacklisted_profiles.description: List the LinkedIn profiles no campaign may target.

blacklist_profiles.title: Blacklist profiles by URL
blacklist_profiles.description: Stop every campaign from targeting the given LinkedIn profiles.

blacklist_profile.title: Blacklist a profile by URN
blacklist_profile.description: Stop every campaign from targeting one LinkedIn profile, by its URN.

remove_blacklisted_profile.title: Remove a profile from the blacklist
remove_blacklisted_profile.description: Allow campaigns to target a blacklisted profile again.

list_blacklisted_companies.title: List blacklisted companies
list_blacklisted_companies.description: List the LinkedIn companies whose employees no campaign may target.

blacklist_companies.title: Blacklist companies
blacklist_companies.description: Stop campaigns from targeting people at the given LinkedIn companies.

remove_blacklisted_company.title: Remove a company from the blacklist
remove_blacklisted_company.description: Allow campaigns to target people at a blacklisted company again.

list_campaigns.title: List campaigns
list_campaigns.description: List the workspace's campaigns with their state, type and settings, optionally inbound or outbound only, or only those accepting added profiles.

accepts_profiles.description: True for only campaigns that accept added LinkedIn profiles.

create_campaign.title: Create a campaign
create_campaign.description: Create a connect, InMail or drip (inbound) campaign with its senders and exclusion rules. Only the shell is created; the audience, schedule and flow are set up in the Aimfox dashboard.

outreach_type.description: connect sends connection requests, inmail sends InMails, drip messages existing 1st-degree connections (the only inbound type).

uses_connection_note.description: True to send a note with connection requests.

inmail_optimization.description: True to send InMails the most credit-efficient way, e.g. free to Open Profiles.

no_pfp.description: True to exclude profiles without a picture.

exclude_active_targets.description: True to exclude profiles targeted by another active campaign.

exclude_previous_targets.description: True to exclude profiles targeted by earlier campaigns.

get_campaign.title: Get a campaign
get_campaign.description: Read one campaign's settings, state and associated data.

update_campaign.title: Update a campaign
update_campaign.description: Rename, start, resume or pause a campaign, change its target count or exclusion rules. Setting ACTIVE starts real LinkedIn outreach.

state.description: ACTIVE to start or resume, PAUSED to pause.

exclude_active_targets.description: True to exclude profiles targeted by another active campaign.

exclude_previous_targets.description: True to exclude profiles targeted by earlier campaigns.

delete_campaign.title: Delete a campaign
delete_campaign.description: Permanently delete a campaign and stop all of its outreach.

get_campaign_metrics.title: Get campaign metrics
get_campaign_metrics.description: Read a campaign's interaction metrics: views, requests, acceptances, messages, replies and rates.

get_campaign_audience.title: Get a campaign's audience
get_campaign_audience.description: List the LinkedIn profiles in a campaign and each one's state.

add_profile_to_campaign.title: Add a profile to a campaign
add_profile_to_campaign.description: Add one LinkedIn profile to a campaign by URL. Fails with a reason such as locked (in another campaign), blocked, alreadyConnected or noPFP. Not for group or event message campaigns.

add_profiles_to_campaign.title: Add profiles with custom variables
add_profiles_to_campaign.description: Add several LinkedIn profiles to a campaign, each with custom variables for personalization. Returns which were added and why others failed.

remove_profile_from_campaign.title: Remove a profile from a campaign
remove_profile_from_campaign.description: Remove a profile from a campaign by URN or public identifier (the part after /in/ in its URL).

get_campaign_custom_variables.title: Get campaign custom variables
get_campaign_custom_variables.description: List the custom variables defined across a campaign's targets.

get_campaign_target_custom_variables.title: Get a target's custom variables
get_campaign_target_custom_variables.description: Read the custom variables set for one target in a campaign.

set_campaign_target_custom_variables.title: Set targets' custom variables
set_campaign_target_custom_variables.description: Set custom variables on campaign targets by URN, for use in message templates.

list_labels.title: List labels
list_labels.description: List the workspace's lead labels with their colours.

create_label.title: Create a label
create_label.description: Create a label for tagging leads, with one of six colours.

color.description: quaternary (gray), secondary (purple), danger (red), yellow, info (blue) or success (green).

update_label.title: Update a label
update_label.description: Rename or recolour a lead label; leads carrying it keep it.

color.description: quaternary, secondary, danger, yellow, info or success.

delete_label.title: Delete a label
delete_label.description: Delete a lead label, removing it from every lead.

search_leads.title: Search leads
search_leads.description: Search the workspace's leads by keywords, companies, education, skills, languages, locations, labels, origin and owning account, paged with start and count.

labels.description: Label ids the lead must carry.

origins.description: Where the lead came from, e.g. campaign ids.

lead_of.description: Account ids whose leads to search.

optimize.description: True to let Aimfox optimize the search.

search_lead_facets.title: Get lead search facets
search_lead_facets.description: Count the values of one facet -- lead_of, origins, current_companies, past_companies, locations, labels, interests, skills or languages -- across leads matching the filters.

name.description: Facet: lead_of, origins, current_companies, past_companies, locations, labels, interests, skills or languages.

labels.description: Label ids the lead must carry.

origins.description: Where the lead came from, e.g. campaign ids.

lead_of.description: Account ids whose leads to search.

optimize.description: True to let Aimfox optimize the search.

count_leads.title: Count leads
count_leads.description: Count the leads matching the search filters without returning them.

labels.description: Label ids the lead must carry.

origins.description: Where the lead came from, e.g. campaign ids.

lead_of.description: Account ids whose leads to search.

optimize.description: True to let Aimfox optimize the search.

get_lead.title: Get a lead
get_lead.description: Read everything Aimfox holds on a lead: profile, experience, contact details, labels and campaign history.

get_lead_custom_variables.title: Get a lead's custom variables
get_lead_custom_variables.description: Read the custom variables set for a lead under one account.

add_label_to_lead.title: Label a lead
add_label_to_lead.description: Add one of the workspace's labels to a lead, e.g. to mark it qualified.

remove_label_from_lead.title: Remove a label from a lead
remove_label_from_lead.description: Take a label off a lead; the label itself stays in the workspace.

list_lead_notes.title: List a lead's notes
list_lead_notes.description: List the notes written on a lead, with their text and timestamps.

create_lead_note.title: Add a note to a lead
create_lead_note.description: Add a free-text note to a lead, visible to the workspace.

update_lead_note.title: Update a lead note
update_lead_note.description: Replace the text of an existing note on a lead.

delete_lead_note.title: Delete a lead note
delete_lead_note.description: Delete a note from a lead permanently; it cannot be restored.

list_conversations.title: List conversations
list_conversations.description: List LinkedIn conversations across the workspace's accounts, newest first, optionally only unread, only campaign conversations, or from given campaigns. Page with before.

in_app.description: True for only Aimfox campaign conversations, false for all -- overriding the workspace privacy setting.

before.description: Only conversations before this UNIX millisecond timestamp, for paging.

campaigns.description: Campaign ids as a JSON array, e.g. ["da858e34-..."].

get_conversation.title: Get a conversation
get_conversation.description: Read a conversation's participants and messages.

get_lead_conversation.title: Find a lead's conversation
get_lead_conversation.description: Look up the URN of an account's conversation with a lead, to read it or reply.

start_conversation.title: Start a conversation
start_conversation.description: Send a LinkedIn message to one or more people from an account. Several recipients form one group chat; an existing conversation with the recipient is reused.

message.description: Message text. Give message, file_identifiers or both.

recipients.description: Recipient account ids; several make one group conversation. Use this or recipient_urns.

recipient_urns.description: Recipient URNs; use this or recipients.

file_identifiers.description: Single-use ids of files uploaded in the Aimfox app or API.

send_message.title: Send a message
send_message.description: Reply in an existing LinkedIn conversation. The message is sent immediately.

message.description: Message text. Give message, file_identifiers or both.

file_identifiers.description: Single-use ids of uploaded files to attach.

mark_conversation_read.title: Mark a conversation read
mark_conversation_read.description: Mark a LinkedIn conversation as seen, clearing its unread state.

react_to_message.title: React to a message
react_to_message.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message, or remove one with unreact.

unreact.description: True to remove the reaction instead.

edit_message.title: Edit a message
edit_message.description: Edit the text of a message the account sent.

delete_message.title: Delete a message
delete_message.description: Delete a message the account sent, for everyone in the conversation.

list_templates.title: List templates
list_templates.description: List the workspace's connection-note, message and InMail templates with usage details.

get_template.title: Get a template
get_template.description: Read one template's type, text, subject and AI setting.

create_template.title: Create a template
create_template.description: Create a connection note, message or InMail template (InMail takes a subject), optionally AI-personalized.

message.description: Template text; may use variables such as {{first_name}}.

ai.description: True to have Aimfox personalize the text with AI.

update_template.title: Update a template
update_template.description: Change a template's name, text, subject or AI setting.

message.description: Template text; may use variables such as {{first_name}}.

ai.description: True to have Aimfox personalize the text with AI.

delete_template.title: Delete a template
delete_template.description: Delete a message, note or InMail template from the workspace.

list_webhooks.title: List webhooks
list_webhooks.description: List the workspace's webhooks with their URLs and events.

create_webhook.title: Create a webhook
create_webhook.description: Send Aimfox events -- account logins, connections, replies, label changes, campaign starts and ends -- to a URL.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives the events.

events.description: Events: account_logged_in, account_logged_out, new_connection, view, connect, accepted, inmail, message, new_reply, reply, inmail_reply, lead_label_added, campaign_ended, campaign_created, campaign_started, inbox_event, campaign_reply.

update_webhook.title: Update a webhook
update_webhook.description: Change a webhook's name, URL, events or the headers sent with deliveries.

events.description: Events: account_logged_in, account_logged_out, new_connection, view, connect, accepted, inmail, message, new_reply, reply, inmail_reply, lead_label_added, campaign_ended, campaign_created, campaign_started, inbox_event, campaign_reply.

headers.description: Extra headers Aimfox sends with each delivery, e.g. {Authorization: Bearer ...}.

delete_webhook.title: Delete a webhook
delete_webhook.description: Delete a webhook; its URL stops receiving events.
